resources.string: Swoop is a keyboard. Android only uses it after you switch it on and choose it. Your old keyboard stays installed, so you can always go back.
Chosen right now: no (another keyboard is in use)

If the buttons do not open the right screen on your tablet: Settings > System > Languages and input > On-screen keyboard > Manage keyboards, switch Swoop on; then tap in any text box and use the keyboard icon at the bottom right (or the notification Choose input method) to pick Swoop.
To go back at any time: tap the keyboard icon (or the Choose input method notification) while typing and pick your old keyboard.
